title: AQLProfile packet golden dump
description: Schema for PMC packet dumps and their referenced agent/IP-discovery files.

uint32_hex.description: A zero-padded 32-bit unsigned value rendered as lowercase hexadecimal.

uint64_hex.description: A zero-padded 64-bit unsigned value rendered as lowercase hexadecimal.

offset_hex.description: A byte offset rendered as lowercase hexadecimal without a fixed width.

dimension_name.description: An AQLProfile coordinate dimension name returned by aqlprofile_iterate_event_coord.

dimension.description: One API-visible counter-result dimension. Dimension order defines mixed-radix counter_id decoding, with the last dimension changing fastest.

position.description: Zero-based callback position returned by aqlprofile_iterate_event_coord.

id.description: Numeric public AQLProfile dimension ID returned by the callback.

extent.description: Number of valid coordinate values in this dimension.

block.description: Metadata for the hardware counter block shared by every case in this file.

name.description: Semantic counter-block name used by config.yaml and the packet request.

__implementation_aqlprofile:block_id.description: Legacy AQLProfile block enum value. This is diagnostic implementation metadata and need not match a Rust implementation.

counter_count.description: Maximum number of simultaneous physical counter slots exposed for one block instance.

dimensions.description: Ordered API-visible result dimensions for this block and topology.

event_definition.description: Minimal basic-event metadata retained from config.yaml.

name.description: Stable symbolic event name used by requests in this dump.

event_id.description: Architecture-specific hardware event selector from config.yaml.

skipped_event.description: Basic event intentionally omitted from packet generation.

event_id.description: Architecture-specific hardware event selector from config.yaml.

reason.description: Machine-readable statement of the exact name-based heuristic used to skip this event.

request_event.description: One event descriptor passed to the PMC packet-generation request.

event.description: Reference to an entry in the root events array by symbolic name.

block_index.description: Exact AQLProfile block_index request field selecting one physical block instance.

flags.description: Exact event flags passed to AQLProfile.

allocation_flags.description: Decoded aqlprofile_buffer_desc_flags_t supplied to the allocation callback.

host_access.description: Whether AQLProfile requested host access to the allocation.

device_access.description: Whether AQLProfile requested device access to the allocation.

allocation.description: One memory allocation requested while constructing this packet profile.

id.description: Symbolic allocation role inferred from how the allocation is used.

observed_call_index.description: Zero-based observed allocation-callback order. This is legacy behavior, not necessarily a required ordering.

base.description: Deterministic virtual address returned by the fixture allocator.

size_bytes.description: Minimum byte size requested through the allocation callback.

flags.description: Access and memory-hint flags supplied with the request.

memory_copy.description: One memcpy callback used by AQLProfile to place a phase's PM4 IB into command memory.

observed_call_index.description: Zero-based observed memcpy-callback order. This is informative rather than normative.

phase.description: Packet phase identified by matching the copy destination to the returned AQL IB target.

destination.description: Symbolic copy destination inside a captured allocation.

allocation.description: Allocation receiving the copied PM4 stream.

offset_bytes.description: Byte offset from the command allocation base.

size_bytes.description: Actual unpadded number of PM4 bytes copied.

output_slot.description: One 8-byte logical slot in the PMC result/output allocation.

size_bytes.description: Logical PMC result-slot size in bytes.

coordinate_observation.description: One coordinate callback emitted by aqlprofile_iterate_event_coord.
coordinate_observation.$comment: position must equal the array index, value must be less than extent, and id/name/extent must match the block dimension catalog.

callback_event.description: Exact aqlprofile_pmc_event_t returned by the iterate_data callback.

sample.description: Observed mapping between one iterate_data callback, its output-buffer slot, and decoded topology coordinates.

counter_id.description: Flattened coordinate ID passed by aqlprofile_pmc_iterate_data; this is not the hardware event_id.

output.description: Output slot identified by the synthetic post-creation tag read by this callback.

aql_packet_reference.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the canonical START AQL packet for another event at the same block index.

allocations_reference.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to an identical canonical allocation transcript.

memory_copies_reference.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to an identical canonical memory-copy transcript.

unreported_output_slots_reference.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to an identical canonical set of unreported output slots.

phase_reference.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to a canonical identical READ or STOP phase for another event at the same block index.

aql_packet.description: Raw 64-byte outer AQL packet containing an INDIRECT_BUFFER command for one phase.

ib_target.description: Symbolic address and placement metadata for the PM4 indirect buffer.

base.description: Symbolic allocation base used by the target address.

offset_bytes.description: Byte offset from command_base encoded in the INDIRECT_BUFFER packet.

align_bytes.description: Command-section alignment returned by CommandBufferMgr::Align(1); generation fails if the base or IB target violates it.

ib_bytes.description: PM4 indirect-buffer size encoded by the AQL wrapper.

uint32_t.description: All 16 raw little-endian AQL dwords as padded hexadecimal strings.

pm4_ib.description: Raw PM4 indirect-buffer payload copied into command memory for one phase.

uint32_t.description: Raw little-endian PM4 dwords in legacy emission order.

pm4_ib.$comment: The uint32_t element count multiplied by four must equal size_bytes.

phase.description: Outer AQL packet and referenced PM4 IB for one START, READ, or STOP phase.

response.description: All captured outputs and callback observations from one successful PMC packet-generation call.

allocations.description: Output and command allocations requested by AQLProfile.

memory_copies.description: Observed PM4 stream copies into the command allocation.

samples.description: API-visible result mapping discovered with post-creation synthetic output tags.

unreported_output_slots.description: Allocated full 8-byte output slots that produced no iterate_data callback.

pmc_case.description: One independent aqlprofile_pmc_create_packets request and captured response.

request.description: Semantic and exact low-level event inputs for this call.

shape.description: Structural request shape derived directly from the number and arrangement of request entries.

events.description: Events supplied together in this PMC profile.

pmc_dump.description: Atomic per-instance and combined all-instance basic PMC packet cases for one block on one topology.

format_version.description: Linear packet-dump format version for compatibility checks.

gfx.description: GPU architecture name used to register the agent.

topology.description: Relative filename of the agent and IP-discovery document used by this dump.

block.description: Shared block facts and result dimensions.

events.description: Basic event catalog referenced by the cases in pmc.

skipped.description: Events detected by the config export but intentionally excluded from packet generation.

byte_order.description: Byte order used when interpreting raw dword arrays.

output_base.description: Canonical deterministic output-allocation address used for packet generation.

command_base.description: Canonical deterministic command-allocation address used for packet generation.

pmc_dump.$comment: Event references, allocation roles, callback indices, offsets, and cross-field size relationships require semantic validation beyond JSON Schema.

agent_info_version.description: Legacy AQLProfile agent-info ABI version used to register this fixture.

cu_bitmap.description: Fixed-shape DRM CU bitmap passed through aqlprofile_agent_info_v2_t.

layout.description: Flattening order of the bitmap dwords.

dimensions.description: Fixed DRM ABI dimensions, independent of the agent's actual se_num.

se.description: Number of SE rows represented by the DRM ABI bitmap.

shader_arrays_per_se.description: Number of shader-array columns represented per SE.

uint32_t.description: Row-major active-CU bitmaps for every fixed SE/SA position.

agent_info.description: Exact semantic topology values passed to aqlprofile_register_agent_info.

xcc_num.description: Number of XCC/XCD partitions on the registered agent.

se_num.description: Total number of shader engines supplied to AQLProfile.

cu_num.description: Total active compute-unit count supplied to AQLProfile.

shader_arrays_per_se.description: Number of shader arrays per shader engine.

domain.description: PCI domain used when resolving IP discovery.

ip_instance.description: One IP-discovery instance corresponding to one on-disk instance directory.

major.description: IP major version read from the major file.

minor.description: IP minor version read from the minor file.

revision.description: IP revision read from the revision file.

num_instance.description: Instance number read from the num_instance file.

base_addr.description: Base-address segments read from the base_addr file, without fixed-array zero padding.

ip.description: One named hardware IP directory and all of its discovered instances.

name.description: Logical IP name such as GC.

instances.description: Discovered instances sorted by instance ID.

ips.description: Named IP blocks discovered on this die.

ip_discovery_dump.description: Agent registration topology and parsed IP-discovery fixture for one gfx architecture.

format_version.description: Linear packet-dump format version for compatibility checks.

gfx.description: GPU architecture described by this topology file.

ip_discovery.description: Logical die/IP/instance hierarchy parsed from the fixture.

dies.description: Discovered dies sorted by die ID.
